senses.gloss: m. pl. (טִלְטֵל) movable goods, chattel, opp. מקרקע immovable property.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 26b:6">Kidd. 26ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 156b:2">B. Bath. 156ᵇ</cite> <he>היו לו מ׳ הרבה</he> had a large fortune in movables.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 4:1">B. Mets. IV, 1</cite> <he>כל מ׳ קונין זה וכ׳</he> all movables (exchanged) buy each other, i.e. taking possession by the one gives possession to the other party; a. v. fr.
